{{Quote|All sliders are served with our special garnish. Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup and Bimm mustard available upon request.|The Dex's Diner menu|<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Mustard''' was an edible item that was served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] as a side order with any [[slider]]s, before its destruction in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Varieties included [[Bimm mustard]] and [[Boontaspiced mustard]].

==Behind the scenes==
Mustard is mentioned in a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive release, "[[Dining at Dex's]]" by [[Gregory Walker]], which represents the [[in-universe]] menu of Dex's Diner. In real life, [[Wikipedia:Mustard (condiment)|mustard]] is a popular condiment made from the ground seeds of [[Wikipedia:Mustard plant|mustard plants]].
